methodology.paths: Exact finite choice-edge sequences; no probability model. Structural median is not expected player behavior. DAG suffix dynamic programming on (choices, words); prefix times suffix for scene reuse. Cycles checked in all definitions.
methodology.words: Unicode letter/digit tokens; internal apostrophes/hyphens retained. Visible bracket and ending headings counted; Markdown punctuation excluded. Narrative_only excludes choices; full_menu includes every available option; selected_option includes selected options only. UI, description, startup, rereading and backtracking excluded.
methodology.duration: Sensitivity assumptions, not empirical Spanish population norms. Seconds = words * 60 / assumed wpm + choices * additional deliberation seconds. Exact joint distribution used; decimal output rounded only by floating conversion.
methodology.convergence: At least two distinct reachable predecessor nodes; parallel choices from one parent excluded.
methodology.reused_scenes: Reachable nonterminal scenes appearing in at least two complete choice sequences; root included.
methodology.editorial: Identical ending sets are diagnostic, not proof alternatives are meaningless; convergences allowed.
